en.headline: Development Bureau reviewing Queen Mary lift reports
en.dek: The bureau said it had received reports from the electrical and buildings departments and aimed to brief the Chief Executive in mid-October.
body: The Development Bureau said on Wednesday it had received investigation reports from the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department and the Buildings Department on lift problems at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block, and was reviewing them.

The bureau said the review would look for shortcomings in construction, acceptance testing and supervision of the lift works, and would consider whether supervision of similar projects could be improved. It said the aim was to submit an investigation report to the Chief Executive in mid-October.

The bureau said the investigation was still under way and that it would not comment at this stage. It said it would later report the findings to the Legislative Council panel on development and account for them in public. Multiple lifts at Clinical Block 1 have been out of service for repairs, and clinical services in the block have not fully opened.

zh.headline: 發展局正審視瑪麗醫院升降機調查報告
zh.dek: 局方稱已收到機電工程署及建築署報告，目標10月中向行政長官提交調查報告。
body: 發展局星期三表示，已收到機電工程署及建築署就瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機問題提交的報告，現正審視內容。
局方稱，審視會查找升降機工程在施工、驗收及監管上有否不足，並探討同類工程的監督制度是否有優化空間。目標是在10月中向行政長官提交調查報告。
發展局表示，調查仍在進行，現階段不宜評論，稍後會向立法會發展事務委員會匯報結果，並公開交代。新臨床大樓多部升降機因工程問題停用維修，臨牀服務至今未能全面啟用。
